description: This file defines a Java class 'MonkeySourceNetwork' which implements 'MonkeyEventSource' and facilitates receiving input commands over the network to simulate user interactions and device control in the Android Monkey testing framework. It handles network connections, parses commands, maps them to internal events, and manages command execution including deferred returns.

classes.name: MonkeyCommandReturn
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of executing a Monkey command, indicating success/failure and an optional message.

classes.name: MonkeyCommand
classes.description: Interface for commands that can be translated from text into Monkey events.

classes.name: FlipCommand
classes.description: Handles flipping the device keyboard open or closed.

classes.name: TouchCommand
classes.description: Handles touch input commands with actions and coordinates.

classes.name: KeyCommand
classes.description: Handles key press and release commands.

classes.name: SleepCommand
classes.description: Handles sleeping the device for a specified duration.

classes.name: TypeCommand
classes.description: Handles typing a string via key events.

classes.name: TapCommand
classes.description: Handles tap commands at specific coordinates.

classes.name: DeferReturnCommand
classes.description: Handles deferring command return until a specific event occurs or timeout.

classes.name: CommandQueueImpl
classes.description: Implementation of command queue to hold pending MonkeyEvents.

classes.name: DeferredReturn
classes.description: Holds deferred return info, allowing waiting for specific events or timeouts.

methods.name: wake

methods.name: getKeyCode
